title: Coherent higher direct images of a projective morphism
statement:
Let $S$ be locally Noetherian, let $f:X\to S$ be
projective, and let
$\mathcal F$ be a coherent module.
Then each higher direct image
$R^qf_*\mathcal F$ is coherent.
For an embedding $X\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_S$, it is zero for $q>n$.

proof.text: The already proved coherence declaration is unchanged: the composite of the closed immersion with projective projection is proper and locally of finite presentation over the locally Noetherian base, so the existing proper coherence theorem applies.

For vanishing, fix any affine open U of S and restrict the embedding using ProjectiveSpace.liftBaseChange. Its cartesian square makes this a closed immersion. The affine scheme U is isomorphic to Spec Gamma(U,top); the projective-space map induced by that isomorphism is a closed immersion by base change. Compose to obtain the required closed embedding of f^{-1}U over Spec Gamma(U,top). Apply subsingleton_H_of_isClosedImmersion to the restricted quasi-coherent module.

Compare this cohomology with open module cohomology and then with sections of R^q f_* F over U. They are subsingleton. Quasi-coherence makes the zero endomorphism epi from surjectivity of all affine-cover section maps; cancellation gives id=0 and IsZero.
